titles.li: Shelter the children from the burned village

texts.li: [their:lowtech] A small village of {FACTION} near {PLACE} has burned down. {GIVER}, one of its people, is bringing {COUNT} children who lost their homes in the fire, and asks the colony to shelter them for a few days.

[their:hightech] A small settlement of {FACTION} near {PLACE} has burned down. {GIVER}, one of its people, is bringing {COUNT} children who lost their homes in the fire, and asks the colony to shelter them for a few days.

[ws:fire,ws:theirs] {WSNAME} at {PLACE} took a small village of {FACTION} nearby with it. {GIVER}, one of its people, is bringing {COUNT} children who lost their homes in the fire, and asks the colony to shelter them for a few days.

[ws:fire,!ws:theirs] With {WSNAME} at {WSPLACE} still on everyone's lips, a small village of {FACTION} near {PLACE} has burned down as well. {GIVER}, one of its people, is bringing {COUNT} children who lost their homes in the fire, and asks the colony to shelter them for a few days.

[ws:war,ws:theirs] A small village of {FACTION} near {PLACE} was burned in {WSNAME}. {GIVER}, one of its people, is bringing {COUNT} children who lost their homes, and asks the colony to shelter them for a few days.

li.label: Shelter them
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} and the children are on their way.

li.label: Decline
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} will take the children to another town.

lines.li: [ask] What should become of the children now?
[takein] Thank you for giving them a home.
[place] Thank you, a new home is more than we hoped for.
[sendon] Thank you for the food, we'll manage from here.

terms.li: If the colony agrees, {GIVER} and the children arrive within a day and stay for about {DAYS}. Each of them needs a bed or sleeping spot under a roof, and meals from the colony's stores: {ITEM} in all. If the stores have no food for them, they eat the little they brought.\n\nAt the end of their stay, {GIVER} will ask the colony what should become of the children. The colony can take them in, and they join the colony. It can find them a home with neighbours, whose people come for them. Or it can give them food and send them on.

accepted.li: {GIVER} and {COUNT} children from the burned village are on their way to the colony.

notes.li: [came] {GIVER} and the children from the burned village have arrived.
[placed] {OTHERPEOPLE} have agreed to give the children a home. Their people will come for the children within a day.
[fetchers] People of {OTHERPEOPLE} have come for the children.

endTitles.li: [place] A new home for the children

ends.li: [takein] The children from the burned village are part of the colony now: {ITEM}. {GIVER} has gone home to {FACTION}.
[place,!samepeople] People of {OTHERPEOPLE} have taken the children to their new home. {GIVER} has gone home to {FACTION}.
[place,samepeople] People from another town of {FACTION} have taken the children to their new home.
[sendon] The colony gave the children food, and they have gone on with {GIVER}.
[harmed] Some of the children from the burned village died while in the colony's care. {FACTION} hold the colony responsible.

texts.li: {GIVER} and the {COUNT} children from the burned village have stayed with the colony for some days. {GIVER} asks what should become of the children now.\n\nThe colony can take them in, and they join the colony as colonists. It can find them a home with neighbours, whose people come for them. Or it can give them food and send them on with {GIVER}.

li.label: Take them in
li.outcome: The children are part of the colony now.

li.label: Find them a home with neighbours
li.outcome: The neighbours' people will come for the children.

li.label: Send them on with food
li.outcome: Food is being carried out to {X_nameDef}, and they will go on.

IncidentDef.label: one of the children comes back

texts.li: [place,visitor] Some seasons ago the colony found a home for the children from the burned village. {NAME}, the eldest, is grown now and wants to come by to thank the colony.
[place,trader] Some seasons ago the colony found a home for the children from the burned village. {NAME}, the eldest, is grown now, trades for {FACTION}, and wants to come by with goods.
[place,joiner] Some seasons ago the colony found a home for the children from the burned village. {NAME}, the eldest, is grown now and wants to come by to ask the colony something.
[sendon,visitor] Some seasons ago the colony gave the children from the burned village food and sent them on. {NAME}, the eldest, is grown now and wants to come by to thank the colony.
[sendon,trader] Some seasons ago the colony gave the children from the burned village food and sent them on. {NAME}, the eldest, is grown now, trades for {FACTION}, and wants to come by with goods.
[sendon,joiner] Some seasons ago the colony gave the children from the burned village food and sent them on. {NAME}, the eldest, is grown now and wants to come by to ask the colony something.

lines.li: [came] I was one of the children you sheltered when our village burned.
[joined] Thank you, I'll do my share here.

terms.li: [visitor] If the colony agrees, {NAME} comes to the gate within a day, stays for some hours and brings a gift of thanks.
[trader] If the colony agrees, {NAME} comes to the gate within a day and stays for some hours. The colony can trade with {NAME} while {NAME} is there.
[joiner] If the colony agrees, {NAME} comes to the gate within a day and will ask to join the colony.

accepted.li: {NAME} is on the way to the colony.

notes.li: [came,visitor] {NAME}, grown now, has come to the gate with a gift for the colony: {TALE}.
[came,trader] {NAME}, grown now, has come to the gate with goods to trade.
[came,joiner] {NAME}, grown now, has come to the gate.

ends.li: [visited] {NAME} visited the colony and has gone on.
[traded] {NAME} traded at the gate and has gone on.
[notjoined] The colony said no, and {NAME} has gone on.

IncidentDef.label: a grown child asks to join

texts.li: {NAME} was the eldest of the children from the burned village, and is grown now. {NAME} asks to join the colony.\n\nIf the colony agrees, {NAME} joins as a colonist.

li.label: Let {X_nameDef} join
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} is part of the colony now.
